title: Hosted a baithak on “Kajri” for Sanchaari – The Delhi Chapter
description: An evening celebrating Kajri, the folk song tradition of the monsoon, that I hosted for Sanchaari – The Delhi Chapter.

title: Promoting Cultural Sensitivity & Inclusion in Arunachal Pradesh
description: My attempt while speaking on ‘Cultural Sensitivity and Inclusion: Engaging Locals & Promoting Perspectives’ was to spark a discussion on the subject with empathy and active listening. So grateful for the opportunity to present my point of view in a seminar of this magnitude.

title: The WhatsApp India Story Launched at India International Centre
description: The WhatsApp India Story: Inside the Digital Maya Sphere, which I co-authored with Sunetra Sen Narayan, was launched at the India International Centre, New Delhi.

title: Release and discussion of India Connected: Mapping the Impact of New Media at Kolkata Press Club
description: Welcome to an insightful event at the Kolkata Press Club where we unveil and discuss my thought-provoking book “India Connected: Mapping the Impact of New Media”. This event brings together experts, scholars, and enthusiasts to explore the transformative power of new media technologies in shaping India’s societal fabric.

title: Information Technology and Indian youth
description: A discussion hosted by Muzaffar Ali on how Information Technology is impacting India and its society. Mr. Nafay Kumail and I were the two experts who contributed to the discussion.

title: India Connected: Exploring the Impact of Smartphones on India’s Future – Book Intro
description: In this video, I delve into the transformative insights presented in the book “India Connected”. Discover how smartphones are reshaping India’s social, political, and economic landscape, providing unprecedented connectivity and access to information.

title: India Connected Book Press Conference: Unveiling the Impact of Smartphones on India’s Future
description: In this exclusive event, experts, scholars, and industry leaders gather to discuss the profound implications of mobile technology on various aspects of Indian society, including communication, politics, economy, and culture. Discover how smartphones have become a catalyst for change, connecting millions and revolutionizing access to information and opportunities.

title: Candid with Shalini Ma’am | 23 years in Government vs 10 years in Private sector?
description: In this episode of Civilsdaily’s Change Maker officer series, Saket met me, an IIS officer of the 1990 batch. I opened up about my experience in government as well as the private sector, drawing on over 32 years of work. Watch the interview to know more.

title: Rajyavardhan Rathore releases book titled “India Connected: Mapping the Impact of New Media”
description: Rajyavardhan Rathore, MoS I&B, released the book “India Connected: Mapping the Impact of New Media”, edited by Dr. Sunetra Sen Narayan and me.

title: New Media in India: From Fad to Fundamental?
description: A lecture by Dr. Sunetra Sen Narayan (Indian Institute of Mass Communication) and me (then an Independent Communications Consultant). This event was co-sponsored by the Institute for Information Policy

title: Should UPSC change its exam pattern? | what Shalini Ma’am has to say?
description: In this episode of Civilsdaily’s Change Maker officer series, Saket met me, an IIS officer of the 1990 batch.

title: Interview with Drs. Sunetra Sen Narayan and Shalini Narayanan
description: Penn State students interviewed Dr. Sunetra Sen Narayan and me on our research about social media’s impact on Indian society, featured in our book “India Connected.”
